metaDescription: The tools I use daily for carpentry, cabinet making, and woodworking. Honest recommendations from a working carpenter.
title: My Carpentry
intro: Every tool here is something I personally use and recommend. No fluff — just the gear that makes my work better.
disclosure: Some links are affiliate links: I earn a small commission if you buy through them, at no extra cost to you. As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.

tools.name: Festool TSC 55 KEB Track Saw
tools.description: My go-to for clean, straight cuts on sheet materials. Essential for cabinet work.

tools.name: Festool Guide Rail 1400 mm
tools.description: The everyday rail for cutting boards to size with the track saw.

tools.name: Festool Guide Rail 2400 mm
tools.description: The long rail for cuts down full-size sheets with the track saw.

tools.name: Festool Domino Joiner
tools.description: Game-changer for strong, fast joinery. Worth every penny.

tools.name: DeWalt Cordless Drill
tools.description: Reliable everyday driver. It comes to almost every job.

tools.name: DeWalt Impact Driver
tools.description: Drives the screws on most of my fits, next to the drill.

tools.name: DeWalt Cordless Jigsaw
tools.description: For curved cuts and quick scribing on site.

tools.name: DeWalt Mitre Saw
tools.description: Cordless, so it goes up into lofts and out into gardens. Trims, battens and deck boards.

tools.name: DeWalt Random Orbital Sander
tools.description: 125 mm and cordless. For birch ply edges and filled MDF before paint.

tools.name: DeWalt Multi-Tool
tools.description: For cuts in place: notches, scribes and trimming on site.

tools.name: Makita Trim Router
tools.description: Small enough for one hand. I run it round templates for curved birch ply parts.

tools.name: DeWalt Finish Nailer
tools.description: For fixing trims, beading and mouldings.

tools.name: Stanley FatMax Tape Measure 5m
tools.description: The yellow tape you see in every photo. Accurate and durable.

tools.name: Irwin Marples Chisels
tools.description: Great edge retention, comfortable grip. Use them daily.

tools.name: Bahco Hand Saw
tools.description: For quick cuts where setting up a power tool isn't worth it.

tools.name: Stabila Spirit Level
tools.description: Accurate and built to survive a building site.

tools.name: Stabila Digital Level
tools.description: Reads the exact angle as well as the bubble.

tools.name: Bosch Laser Measure
tools.description: Instant room measurements. Saves hours on site surveys.

tools.name: DeWalt Laser Level
tools.description: Throws a level line along a whole wall for fitting wardrobes and panelling.

tools.name: Shinwa Combination Square
tools.description: Precision marking for joinery and cabinet work.

tools.name: Incra T-Rule
tools.description: Dead accurate for marking out cuts on boards.

tools.name: Henry Vacuum
tools.description: For the clean-up before I leave a job.

tools.name: SketchUp Pro
tools.description: I design every project in 3D before building. Non-negotiable.

tools.name: Cabinetos
tools.description: My own app — automatic cut lists, parts lists, and board optimisation.

footerCtaSubtitle: I write about tools and techniques on my blog. Check it out for honest reviews and tips.
